messages:
Eva: Quick update — I ran an A/B on the new quantized candidate rwd-llama2-13b-q4f vs baseline on the summarization route (1k samples each, production prompt set).
Ben: Nice. high level numbers?
Eva: paste from eval-bot below — short summary: latency p50 down ~38%, p95 down ~22%, but primary quality metric (ROUGE-L) dropped and hallucination increased slightly.
Eva: ```
Run: ab_test_2026-03-20_q4f
samples: 1000 per arm
latency: baseline p50=420ms p95=980ms | q4f p50=260ms p95=760ms
throughput: tokens/s baseline=1200 | q4f=1850
metrics:
  rouge_l: baseline=37.8 | q4f=36.9 | delta=-2.38% (p=0.012)
  semantic_similarity(SBERT): baseline=0.81 | q4f=0.79 | delta=-2.5%
  hallucination_rate (QA-check): baseline=6.2% | q4f=9.1% | delta=+46% (p=0.004)
  downstream_error_rate (extraction tasks): baseline=1.1% | q4f=1.6% | delta=+45%
notes: regressions concentrated on long-context (>2048 tokens) and multi-step instruction prompts.
``` 
Carlos: Oof — that hallucination jump is the big red flag. Our current canary gate is max -1% on primary metric or +3% hallucination for auto-rollback, right?
Sam: Current infra policy: auto-rollback if primary metric drops >2% OR hallucination increases >3% OR downstream_error_rate >4% for the canary window. But ML usually wants tighter checks for quantized variants.
Ben: For a quantized bring-up I’d prefer stricter thresholds and smaller increments. Suggest: primary metric delta threshold = -0.75% (absolute relative) and hallucination threshold = +1.5%.
Eva: I also want per-route gating — summarization/factual QA are more sensitive than chit-chat. Shouldn't treat them the same.
Sam: Proposed rollout plan:
  - Stage 0: internal smoke only (10k offline prompts) — done.
  - Stage 1: canary 2% traffic for 12h (monitor p50/p95, rouge_l, hallucination, downstream errors)
  - Stage 2: 5% traffic for 48h (manual pause at end of stage to review failing prompts)
  - Stage 3: 20% for 7d with daily checks, then 50% if stable.
Auto-rollback rules during canary: any one of these fires -> immediate rollback:
  - rouge_l drop <= -0.75% (stat sig)
  - hallucination_rate increase >= +1.5% (stat sig)
  - downstream_error_rate increase >= +2%
  - p95 latency increase >+10% (to avoid tail regressions)
Ben: Also add an experiment tag for queries >2048 tokens and route them to baseline until we fix kernels. That will reduce signal noise.
Eva: I want a watchlist of 100 seed prompts that previously flagged regressions; if any of those flip fail, we stop rollout.
ops-bot: noted. Will enforce canary percentages and will trigger rollback webhooks to the serving layer if auto-rollback conditions are met.
eval-bot: scheduled daily batch eval against long-context suite and factuality checks; will post diffs to #eng-ml-evals.
Carlos: OK. Action items:
  - Eva: update canary config with the stricter thresholds & per-route exceptions (2h)
  - Sam: implement traffic split + ops-bot rollback hook (today)
  - Ben: run targeted long-context kernel tests and try 8-bit fallback on worst-case prompts (24h)
  - Carlos: prepare a short report for PMs/CS on likely user impact if we proceed (48h)
Eva: I’ll hold the manual gate at 5% until we review the watchlist. No auto-promotion past 5% without a manual sign-off. :thumbsup:
Ben: SGTM. Thanks all.
